clinical_intent: I have a 72-year-old male with a 2 cm prostate cancer (Gleason 3+3, Stage T1c, PSA 6.0) who has end-stage renal disease on hemodialysis (3 times weekly). He has a well-functioning arteriovenous fistula in his left arm. He has a history of renal cell carcinoma treated with right nephrectomy 10 years ago. He is on warfarin for atrial fibrillation (target INR 2.0-3.0, current INR 2.4). He wants definitive treatment. Given his ESRD, warfarin use, and solitary kidney history, should I recommend LDR brachytherapy? How do I manage his warfarin and dialysis schedule around the procedure? What dose modifications are needed?
